claims.text: A 14-year-old patient presented to the hospital after a fall from height during recreational activity, without loss of consciousness, with twisting trauma of the left ankle. Examination showed pain and functional impairment of the affected limb, palpable distal pulses, good capillary filling and no motor or sensory deficit. Radiographs revealed a Tillaux fracture of the distal left tibia with a confirmed Salter-Harris type IV injury and a posterior malleolus fracture on the lateral view.
